service.en: Change of employer for a domestic worker
service.ar: تغيير صاحب العمل لعامل مساعدة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کے آجر کی تبدیلی

about: An employer amends the status of a domestic worker already in the country by taking over as the new employer.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 515 for the change of employer
Any fines on the worker must also be paid
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
